vulnerability.name: CVE-2022-47630
vulnerability.description: Out-of-bounds read in Arm Trusted Firmware-A's i.MX platform SiP/PSCI handler (plat/imx/common/imx_sip_handler.c and plat/imx/imx8m/imx8m_psci.c).

statements.impact_statement: MESA vendors a single file from ARM Trusted Firmware-A v2.8.0: lib/libc/memset.c (vendored as src/lm_utils_memset.c, upstream commit 9881bb93). This file is a standalone memset() implementation with no dependencies on TF-A platform code, secure-world services, or boot chain infrastructure. CVE-2022-47630 is in the i.MX platform SiP/PSCI handler, which is not present in MESA.

vulnerability.name: CVE-2023-31339
